hostedBoundaryProbe.mode: unauthenticated POST; no credentials and no user data
hostedBoundaryProbe.responseSummary: JSON-RPC Unauthorized with WWW-Authenticate Bearer resource_metadata challenge

adoptionRule.selfHostedCurrentness: pin a stable release/image and verify before use
adoptionRule.hostedCurrentness: hosted endpoint is independently observed at call time and is not equated with a pinned repository release

truthBoundary: The probe proves the hosted MCP endpoint was reachable and auth-guarded at observation time. It grants no access and proves no resume/application state. Product case state is not employer truth.
